   **Pricing and paywall.**
      5 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 26, 2026 - Sep 1, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _khaldonalsalami_, Sep 1, 2026, 1/5: "useless just want to cancel subscription"
            2. _Zani Fourie_, Aug 27, 2026, 1/5: "Basically just a calorie counting app, and I can't see how much I logged yesterday. The private coaching is very expensive compared to the app price it's not included. Every time you cancel or go back from an offer they offer it to you at an even cheaper price so they catch you with the bigger price if you don't know this and select and pay for it which I think is quite shameful."
            3. _DeOsha Ann_, Aug 29, 2026, 4/5: "I love the everyday workouts 💪 I just wish the BetterMe Tracker wasn't so expensive, I'd buy it. Customer service is very good with their response times and are very helpful."
